ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: "Race and Mixed-Race: Changing Racial Classification in the U.S." Meets with AAS 299 and SOC 396. This class will focus specifically on the history of racial classification in the U.S. with special attention to the census and the role of the state more generally in defining race. The emphasis will be on how race-mixing has been understood in American culture, and on the current literature on "multiracials" and the future of "race" in the US.
